import ctypes

# Allocate two chunks of memory
chunk1_size = 10
chunk2_size = 10

# Allocate memory using ctypes
chunk1 = ctypes.create_string_buffer(chunk1_size)
chunk2 = ctypes.create_string_buffer(chunk2_size)

# Fill the first chunk with some data
data = b"Hello, World!"
chunk1.value = data

# Copy the contents of the first chunk into the second chunk
ctypes.memmove(chunk2, chunk1, min(chunk1_size, chunk2_size))

# Print the contents of the second chunk
print(chunk2.value.decode('utf-8'))

# Free the memory (in ctypes, memory is automatically managed, but we can simulate freeing by setting to None)
del chunk1
del chunk2

def merge_chunks(chunk1, chunk2):
    # Abubuwan da ke cikin chunk 1
    items1 = set(chunk1)
    # Abubuwan da ke cikin chunk 2
    items2 = set(chunk2)
    
    # Abubuwan da ke cikin chunk 1 kuma chunk 2
    merged = items1 | items2
    
    # Abubuwan da ke cikin chunk 1 kuma chunk 2 kuma da ke cikin chunk 1 kuma chunk 2
    intersection = items1 & items2
    
    # Abubuwan da ke cikin chunk 1 kuma chunk 2 kuma da ke cikin chunk 1 kuma chunk 2
    only_in_chunk1 = items1 - items2
    only_in_chunk2 = items2 - items1
    
    # Tare da da ƙarin da ke cikin chunk 1 kuma chunk 2
    result = {
        'merged': sorted(list(merged)),
        'intersection': sorted(list(intersection)),
        'only_in_chunk1': sorted(list(only_in_chunk1)),
        'only_in_chunk2': sorted(list(only_in_chunk2))
    }
    
    return result
